request.style: English, warm male solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, soft drums, gentle and reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ben-Abinadab served the king
In charge of the land of Dor
He supplied provisions for the house
Where Solomon's word was known

[Chorus]
Solomon's daughter Taphath
Was his wife, the text says
A bond of flesh and spirit
In the days of old

[Verse]
Twelve officers oversaw the land
Each with their own specific charge
Ben-Abinadab held his post
In the region near the shore

[Chorus]
Solomon's daughter Taphath
Was his wife, the text says
A bond of flesh and spirit
In the days of old

[Bridge]
He had Solomon's daughter Taphath
As his wife, the verse declares
A connection of family and duty
In the royal palace

[Outro]
Solomon's daughter Taphath
Was his wife, the text says
